items.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
items.summary: A mathematician who works for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic claims he has solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of the company's AI tool Claude. It marks the second time in recent months that an AI company or someone linked to one claims to have cracked a famed unsolved math problem.

items.title: Microsoft’s final Outlook outage report details testing gaps and safeguards that backfired
items.summary: Microsoft says the bug behind last week's global Outlook outage hit only newer servers in a key part of its network, and tests run on older ones missed it. Its final report lists 13 fixes, including steps to keep a failure in one part of the world from spreading. Read More

items.title: nginx2root: Five new nginx vulnerabilities, and how Cloudflare protects origins from the worst of them
items.summary: Five memory corruption bugs in nginx, called nginx2root, can let an unauthenticated attacker run code on a server. Here’s how they work, and why origins behind Cloudflare's proxy are shielded from the most serious of these bugs.

items.title: How Cloudflare WAF helps protect against Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938)
items.summary: Java4Shell is a critical memory-corruption flaw in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder that can lead to remote code execution. Cloudflare has released six WAF managed rules for paid plans that logs matching requests by default. Patch your Java runtimes now.
